plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Biology A.S. Degree - CalGETC' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 25, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7998/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 67-69; lower bound 67 encoded = 15+17+16+19 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 MATH 400/355 -> 4; Sem 2 MATH 401/356 -> 4). LINKED MATH SEQUENCES: Semester 1 offers MATH 400 Calculus I (5 units; pre-req MATH 370 or MATH 372 AND Math 373) or MATH 355 Calculus for Biology and Medicine I (4 units; pre-req MATH 373 or MATH 384). Semester 2 offers MATH 401 Calculus II (5 units; pre-req MATH 400) or MATH 356 Calculus for Biology and Medicine II (4 units; pre-req MATH 355). Take the sequences consistently: MATH 400 -> MATH 401; MATH 355 -> MATH 356. The Semester 2 MATH slot prerequisite is encoded as one_of MATH 400/MATH 355 (MATH 355 appears only as a Semester 1 option, so it is carried under external_prereqs for validator code-resolution). CHEM 400 pre-req per map: Intermediate Algebra or equivalent AND CHEM 300 or CHEM 305 or CHEM 309 (prior chemistry and algebra placement; documented here, not encoded as plan prerequisites). BIOL 400 pre-req per map: (CHEM 400 or CHEM 305) and MATH 120; encoded as CHEM 400 (the in-plan course), with CHEM 305/MATH 120 documented here. BIOL 420 and CHEM 421 carry GE AREA 'CRC Area L5' in the map (apparent typo in a CalGETC map; the parallel courses in Semesters 1-3 carry Cal-GETC Area 5A/5B & 5C); they are major courses, encoded without a GE core_area. Advisories (recommended, not required): BIOL 400, BIOL 410, BIOL 420 advisory eligibility for ENGWR 300. Semester 1: map recommends meeting with a counselor (Area 1A).
